name: domain-bot
description: 自进化领域专家 bot —— 千 bot 工厂需求命题的假门测试探针

scripts.start: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/cli.js run --persona=all
scripts.collect: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/cli.js collect
scripts.edit: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/cli.js edit
scripts.review: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/cli.js review
scripts.publish-feed: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/cli.js publish
scripts.calibrate: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/cli.js calibrate
scripts.ingest: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/cli.js ingest
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/cli.js doctor
